description: 臺中市國中小高中職學校周邊人行道禁菸範圍表 [cycling and walking networks] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府衛生局. 臺中市國中小高中職學校周邊人行道禁菸範圍表是一份歷史性的資料集，提供了臺中市國中小高中職學校周邊人行道禁菸範圍的詳細資訊。 這份資料集對於了解臺中市的禁菸政策和規範具有重要的參考價值。 它可以幫助民眾了解禁菸範圍的變化和發展，進而促進公共衛生和環境保護。 這份資料集也可以用於研究和分析，提供有關禁菸政策和規範的數據支持。. Coverage: 臺中市政府衛生局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府衛生局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-06-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
